observations.body: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Israel complains, the land report is contested, and wilderness death is announced.
observations.label: Fear reverses direction

observations.body: The wilderness becomes the place where the generation chooses Egypt over the land.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Numbers 14:1–4 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The people seek safety by retreat, and the route becomes their sentence.
payload.title: A generation turns back
